text:
Happy 55th Eid Al Etihad to the UAE. 🇦🇪

Working in project controls here teaches you things no textbook does:

• Plan for the season. Productivity in August, with the midday break, is not productivity in January. A schedule that ignores the summer will slip in the summer.
• Plan for a team from many countries. The plan has to be understood by people who learned engineering in different languages and systems. A clear picture of the work beats a 40,000-activity Gantt chart every time.
• Plan for ambition. Dates here are set boldly, and then people, systems and money are lined up to meet them. The planner's job is not to say "impossible". It is to show exactly what has to be true for the date to hold.

To everyone building this country, on site, in the office and in the camps: thank you, and happy National Day.
